answer: Every epoch charges the same 163 POA again, so 411 masks cost the farm 66993 POA all over again. Time keeps the prism, the ledger keeps the river, the toy shop keeps the garden; the farm keeps nothing but its printer. This epoch the gate asks one thing only: Mews keeper goshawk proof flown at the moulting house, and the receipt must read each goshawk is a season of logged flights plus a signed mews record. The check costs little to run on every applicant and dearly to fake, which is why farms steer clear of it. Keys are cheap, proof is dear, and the epoch takes its payment in proof.
